content:
incident-bot: Pager: high - auth-provider errors spike (third-party). Observed: token introspect 5xx/504s and JWKS fetch failures. Paging oncall-rotation.

oncall-rotation: I'm on it, looking now.

maya (sre): seeing a ~30% login failure rate to the web console starting ~2141599950. Okta introspect returning 502s and our auth proxy logs show `jwks fetch error` repeated.

liam (eng): confirming - our edge is failing when contacting `https://okta.example.com/.well-known/jwks.json`. Curl from a control host times out.

jessica (support): we have at least two customers reporting console access blocked; CS is triaging and sending temporary guidance.

maya (sre): initial impact: console sign-in fails UI-side, mobile apps still pass in some cases due to cached keys but token verification fails for new sessions.

incident-bot: Incident file created: INCIDENT-2141599999. Severity: P2 -> escalate if breach 50%.

liam (eng): mitigation plan: 1) enable cached JWKS fallback in authz-proxy (use stale-if-error), 2) increase JWKS cache TTL to 15m, 3) add a temporary maintenance banner on status.redwood.ai.

maya (sre): rolling the authz-proxy change now (config snippet):
```
authz_proxy:
  jwks_cache_ttl: 15m
  jwks_stale_if_error: true
```

liam (eng): rolling canary applied to us-east-1 -> patch logs show `using stale jwks` on fetch error.

okta-status-bot: Okta incident: Customers may experience intermittent errors when retrieving JWKS (internal ref #OKTA-51234). Current status: Investigating.

diana (product): recommend calling out console-only impact and that API tokens already minted are unaffected.

jessica (support): posting note to customers in-app and updating existing tickets: "We're seeing an upstream JWKS retrieval issue from Okta causing new logins to fail for some users. Working on fallback; temporary workaround may be to retry or use existing sessions."

maya (sre): manual mitigation verification: performed sign-in tests -> new interactive sign-ins now succeed in ~80% of cases after the stale-jwks fallback. Some edge sessions still fail when introspect hits 5xx.

liam (eng): adding an additional short-term mitigation: increase introspect retry policy in auth-proxy: `retries: 3, backoff: 500ms`.

maya (sre): note: we need to avoid overloading Okta while it's degraded; set circuit breaker window for introspect to 10s and error threshold 50%.

incident-bot: Handoff requested at 2141600200 to next oncall; oncall-rotation to confirm.

oncall-rotation: confirmed, handing off. Summary: Okta JWKS retrieval issues causing console login failures; stale-jwks fallback enabled; increased cache TTL; retry/backoff applied. Continued monitoring + vendor coordination.

liam (eng): reaching out to Okta support with trace sample and timestamps. Sent ticket #INC-RED-309.

okta-status-bot: Update: Okta reports degraded CDN edge causing JWKS propagation delays for some regions. They are deploying fixes.

maya (sre): customer impact update: approx 15% of interactive logins failed during peak; most recovered after our fallback. No API token invalidations observed. CS notified top customers.

jessica (support): adding proactive outreach message for top 10 customers and opening priority tickets.

liam (eng): logs/queries I used:
```bash
# check jwks fetch errors
grep -i "jwks fetch" /var/log/authz-proxy/*.log | tail -n 50
# introspect 5xx counts
aws logs query --query-string "fields @timestamp, @message | filter @message like /introspect/ and @message like /5../"
```

maya (sre): postmortem notes to collect: timeline of Okta errors, our mitigation actions & timing, customer impact buckets, whether stale-if-error should be permanent, and runbook gap for vendor-jwks flakiness.

diana (product): publish status page: note that this is an upstream degradation with mitigation in place; include ETA unknown.

incident-bot: Incident status updated: monitoring. Last check-in at 2141600300.

maya (sre): leaving final action items for next rotation: follow Okta support updates, decide on permanent jwks_stale_if_error policy, and prepare postmortem draft.

oncall-rotation: acknowledged, closing handoff. Will update if Okta fully recovers or if customer impact grows. :thumbsup:
